_comment: «Лишнее» (Settings → Apps → Programs → Extras; scripts/programs.py bloat-status | bloat), like
Omarchy's «Remove preinstalls»: what the dotfiles' installer puts on a system that angelOS itself
never calls. A group's packages are shown when installed; "ticked": preselected. What the user
removed here goes into ~/.local/state/angelos/removed-packages.txt and install.sh never brings it
back (pacman_install, follow_system; apps-install.py's base packages). A package the user's
settings name (the terminal, the task manager, the file manager) stays, so does one something
else installed needs. "catalog": the installed apps of data/apps-catalog.json (the wizard's).

groups.hintRu: мелочи автора из packages/tools.txt — angelOS их не вызывает
groups.hintEn: the author's small tools from packages/tools.txt; angelOS never calls them

btop: a resource monitor (the task manager falls back to another)
ncdu: what takes space in a folder

groups.hintRu: у angelOS для этого свои окна (звук, диспетчер) или они нужны редко
groups.hintEn: angelOS has its own windows for these (sound, task manager), or they are rarely needed

scrcpy: a phone's screen on the computer
